summary: Tested the new 'Share Post via DM' feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passing in /app/backend/tests/test_share_post.py (recipients list, auth guard, search, self-filter, 404/400/422 edges, successful share creating/reusing direct conversation, placeholder vs note content, shared_post payload fields, recipient notification 'shared a post with you', text-message regression). Frontend: Logged in as testuser, opened /post/post_433af74f4413 (share-btn visible after star), dialog data-testid=share-post-dialog opens, lists 3 recipients by default (followers/following), send-btn disabled until recipient selected, search 'new' returns newuser456, selecting enables send, note typed, send fires POST /api/posts/{id}/share -> toast 'Sent to 1 person' shown, dialog closes/resets. As newuser456, /chat shows the conversation with preview 'TEST ui share e2e', clicking opens chat with 10 shared-post-cards (data-testid=shared-post-card-post_433af74f4413) rendering author name 'Mehmet Kocagöz' + square image + caption + note underneath; clicking a card navigates to /post/post_433af74f4413. Notifications dropdown shows 'Test User shared a post with you' entries. Feed PostCard has data-testid=share-btn-post_{id}. Mobile 390px viewport: no horizontal overflow on PostDetail or share dialog. Regression: plain text messages still delivered correctly (preview 'sent you a message: TEST plain text').

issues: Pre-existing leftover TEST_CHAT_LOC posts render as red/broken squares (missing images). Not related to Share feature but polluting the feed; main agent may want to prune TEST_* seed posts.

action_items: Optional: prune TEST_CHAT_LOC_* posts seeded by previous iterations - they clutter the feed with broken images.
Optional UX: NotificationBell button has no data-testid='notification-bell' (test harness found it only via '11' badge text). Add testid for easier automation.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/share.py: when `q` is < 2 chars but truthy, the current code falls through to the followers/following default list rather than returning an empty 'needs more chars' response. Harmless, matches intent per spec, but the frontend dialog triggers an API call on every keystroke (debounced 300ms) which could be reduced to only call when q.length>=2 to save round trips.

share_post always re-notifies on every share (expected). But each share also creates a new post_share chat_messages row even if the same post was already shared to the same recipient seconds ago - no dedupe. Acceptable per spec, worth noting.

chat.py send_message notification preview uses English literal strings ('shared a post with you', 'sent you a message:'); project is Turkish-facing. Consider i18n or Turkish copy if the product targets Turkish users.

success_rate.frontend: 100% share-feature flows (PostDetail share, dialog, search, send, chat card render, card->post navigation, notification preview, feed share button, mobile overflow)

test_credentials: testuser@looksy.com / test1234 (men) and newuser456@looksy.com / test1234 (women) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Several post_share chat messages between testuser (user_899a61a17955) and newuser456 (user_2e79eca385b6) for post_433af74f4413. Plus one TEST plain-text chat message. All stay inside the two test users; Mehmet Kocagöz was NOT contacted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Share-post-via-DM feature is fully functional. The two test users already share a conversation with many post_share messages (~10 shared cards + 1 text) - any new runs will append more. If feed clutter from TEST_CHAT_LOC_* posts bothers testing, main agent can delete them. notification-bell lacks a data-testid; locate via badge count text or button role.
rca of the issue: No issues found; feature works per spec.
